method: Reviewed original USGS products for generalized habitat context only. Every additional map block needs a separate source record, file digest, metadata review and import.

sources.name: Offshore Cape Mendocino seafloor character
sources.rights: USGS public-domain data; credit USGS and CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab. Not for navigation.
sources.limitations: Historical video-supervised substrate model; downsampled display polygons omit small patches. Bathymetry's reported vertical reference is instantaneous sea level, so no legal 200-foot depth qualification is inferred. No fish or catch verification.

sources.name: Offshore Monterey 2 m seafloor character
sources.class_name: Historical rock and boulder, rugose seabed
sources.rights: USGS metadata specifies CC0 public-domain data and asks attribution to USGS and CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab. Not for navigation.
sources.limitations: The 2 m video-supervised substrate classification encodes substrate as the ones digit, depth zone in tens and slope class in increments of 50. This import selects class 3 only, then generalizes to 10 m; it is historical habitat context, not an individual-rock outline, surveyed MLLW depth, legal fishing position or catch prediction. The paired bathymetry is NAVD88 and requires a reviewed local MLLW conversion before depth qualification. The dataset footprint crosses two browsing sectors; no whole-sector coverage is implied.
